name: Ulnar Impaction Syndrome
definition: Degenerative overload of the ulnocarpal joint, often associated with positive ulnar variance and TFCC/ulnar-sided carpal injury.

investigations.principle: Weight-bearing/variance-sensitive radiographs plus MRI may demonstrate ulnocarpal degeneration and TFCC changes.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Persistent structural overload may require ulnar-shortening or arthroscopic procedures.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Manibandha-Sandhi overload phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Degenerative overload of the ulnocarpal joint, often associated with positive ulnar variance and TFCC/ulnar-sided carpal injury.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
